subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam?
rationale: This is a permanent plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser trust-model choice; automation can point to the overlap and security blockers but should not choose the public API shape for maintainers.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
options.body: Use the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam as the permanent plugin page API and add launch-token/session hardening there.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Resolution
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it as not-ready until the broader Control UI contribution RFC settles the plugin UI API shape.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptors
recommendation.body: Use the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam as the permanent plugin page API and add launch-token/session hardening there.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current `surface: "tab"` Control UI descriptor seam that the decision would either extend or intentionally split from.
